questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Archaeological interpretation depends on the context of incomplete evidence.
options: Archaeological interpretation depends on the context of incomplete evidence.
An object's location is irrelevant once it has been found.
Only large and valuable objects matter.
The absence of an object proves that it never existed.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Archaeological interpretation depends on the context of incomplete evidence.

source.en: Preserving context is essential because the loss of these relationships cannot always be repaired by keeping the objects themselves.
